author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
Fan of Kitchen Table skirmish games? Like Kill Team or Warcry? RedMakers has got you covered with WARCODE and were kind enough to send along a copy for us to do a First Look. Let's dive in!

It's up on Gamefound HERE: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/redmakers/the-warcode-stl-campaign

GMG is publicly supported. Become a backer on Patreon to ensure new content and that the Studio can continue: https://www.patreon.com/guerrillaminiaturegames 

Join us on DISCORD: https://discord.com/invite/XTqqxctryq

Want to challenge Ash to a game? Email him at GuerrillaMiniatureGames@gmail.com or message him through his Facebook Page!

Follow Ash on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/outofthebasementintothestreets

GMG Measuring Gauges and Tokens available HERE: http://deathraydesigns.com/product-category/accessories/guerrilla-miniature-games/

GMG T-Shirts and Hoodies HERE: https://shop.spreadshirt.ca/guerrillaminiaturegames/

Intro and Outro music used via Creative Commons "Benji" by Dyalla
title: FIRST LOOK! - WARCODE by RedMakers

author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Eighty-Six! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

It's time for some FREE Indie Game goodness in the form from FROM THE ASHES. A 1/100th scale Company Level combat game, this sci-fi army-clash pits everything from Zombies and Lasers to Tanks and Hardsuits against each other in a modern-combat sim. Let's check it out!

Check out the the game and rosters for FREE HERE: https://voidscarminiatures.com/from-ashes-rules-downloads/
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 086 - From the Ashes  by Void Scar Miniatures
